question: Is Nomex fabric safe to use inside a lunar habitat at 34% oxygen?
claim: PSI cannot say whether Nomex is safe at 34% O2: of the 10 Nomex tests, the ones that state oxygen were run between 21.0 and 22.2% O2, all below 34%, and none states pressure or partial gravity.
summary_student: NASA burned Nomex samples in space 10 times across BASS-II, BASS and Saffire-II, but every test that recorded its oxygen level used air close to normal Earth air, between 21.0 and 22.2% oxygen. No Nomex test was run at 34% oxygen, at reduced habitat pressure or in lunar gravity, so this data cannot tell you whether Nomex is safe or unsafe in a lunar habitat.
summary_professional: The PSI tests table holds 10 microgravity Nomex tests: 3 in PSI-25 (BASS-II), 6 in PSI-26 (BASS) and 1 in PSI-99 (Saffire-II, combined PMMA and Nomex sample). PSI-25 Nomex tests span 21.0 to 22.2% O2 (calibrated initial O2) and the PSI-99 test is at 22.1% O2 (approximate, derived from CO2 production); all 3 PSI-25 and the 1 PSI-99 tests with stated O2 are below the 34% O2 threshold of the question, while the 6 PSI-26 tests do not state O2. No Nomex row states ambient pressure or a test outcome, so the 34% O2 lunar-habitat condition lies outside the tested range.

params.sql: SELECT lower(replace(investigation, '-', '')) || '_nomex_tests' AS name, count(*) AS value, 'tests' AS unit, investigation, source_table, list(source_row ORDER BY source_row) AS source_rows, list(DISTINCT json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.fuel')) AS source_columns FROM tests WHERE lower(fuel) LIKE '%nomex%' GROUP BY investigation, source_table UNION ALL SELECT lower(replace(investigation, '-', '')) || '_nomex_o2_min' AS name, min(o2_pct_min) AS value, '% O2' AS unit, investigation, source_table, list(source_row ORDER BY source_row) AS source_rows, list(DISTINCT json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.o2_pct_min')) AS source_columns FROM tests WHERE lower(fuel) LIKE '%nomex%' AND o2_pct_min IS NOT NULL GROUP BY investigation, source_table UNION ALL SELECT lower(replace(investigation, '-', '')) || '_nomex_o2_max' AS name, max(o2_pct_max) AS value, '% O2' AS unit, investigation, source_table, list(source_row ORDER BY source_row) AS source_rows, list(DISTINCT json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.o2_pct_max')) AS source_columns FROM tests WHERE lower(fuel) LIKE '%nomex%' AND o2_pct_max IS NOT NULL GROUP BY investigation, source_table UNION ALL SELECT lower(replace(investigation, '-', '')) || '_nomex_tests_below_threshold' AS name, count(*) AS value, 'tests' AS unit, investigation, source_table, list(source_row ORDER BY source_row) AS source_rows, list(DISTINCT json_extract_string(field_sources, '$.o2_pct_max')) AS source_columns FROM tests WHERE lower(fuel) LIKE '%nomex%' AND o2_pct_max IS NOT NULL AND o2_pct_max < 34 GROUP BY investigation, source_table

method.formula: The values returned by the SQL query in params, one row per value, each with the source rows it used.

assumptions: Every row whose fuel name contains Nomex was counted as a Nomex test, including the Nomex blend and Nomex III samples of BASS and the combined PMMA and Nomex sample of Saffire-II (PSI-99).
PSI-25 oxygen is read from the Calibrated initial O2 % by vol column; PSI-99 oxygen is the approximate Percent O2 (Note 1) value, which the table says is derived from measured CO2 production.
The 34% O2 level is taken from the question as the lunar habitat condition to compare against.
limitations: No Nomex test in PSI reached 34% O2, so these data cannot show how Nomex burns, or whether it burns at all, at that oxygen level; no test there means no data, not safe or unsafe.
The 6 PSI-26 (BASS) Nomex tests do not state their oxygen level, so they cannot be placed relative to 34% O2.
No Nomex row states ambient pressure, so the effect of a reduced habitat pressure is not covered.
All Nomex tests were in microgravity; there is no Nomex test in lunar or other partial gravity in PSI.
The Nomex rows carry no outcome field (such as extinction or sustained burning), so this finding counts tests and oxygen levels only and does not report flammability results.
warnings: PSI has no partial-gravity combustion data. Lunar and Mars conclusions are bounded by microgravity and Earth-gravity results only.

chart.idea: Oxygen levels of each Nomex test in BASS-II and Saffire-II as points per investigation, with a dashed line at the 34% O2 lunar habitat level of the question and a note that the BASS Nomex tests state no O2.
